subject: Post-call recap: TraverseBank cost playbook & pilot asks
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@traversebank.com>; Samir Patel <samir.p@traversebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: TraverseBank cost playbook & pilot asks

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the 30-minute call today. Quick recap and the next steps we agreed on so everyone has a single source of truth. I kept it focused on the cost / TCO levers we discussed.

Summary of pain points you shared
- Peak latency spikes for the fraud ruleset generator at end-of-day processing windows (target SLO 150ms).
- Token spend is the top budget pressure; current ML infra costs are eating into roadmap funding.
- Need predictable monthly spend for a pilot (finance requires a committed cap).

Goals we aligned on
1) Validate inference unit economics for the fraud ruleset pipeline at 5k QPS peak and 500k tokens/day baseline.
2) Demonstrate 30–40% token cost reduction with batching + KV prefix caching for the generator path.
3) Propose a 90-day pilot with a hard monthly cap to satisfy procurement.

Redwood cost levers we recommended
- Continuous batching: aggregated token-level batching for generator model (expect ~22–30% token reduction on your workload mix).
- KV/prefix caching: reuse of rule templates and partial outputs (~8–12% additional token reduction for templated prompts).
- Quantization/variant routing: route lower-cost LLM variants for non-critical scoring (savings variable; we model as a sensitivity).

Recommended pilot scope (lightweight + measurable)
- Duration: 90 days; sandboxed project in your VPC with model pin to v2.1-generation (can switch to v2.1-quant for part of traffic).
- Metrics: cost per 1M tokens, 95th pct latency, cache hit rate, and quality regression (synthetic evals we define).
- Acceptance: meet cost target (<= $X per 1M tokens) and no >5% regression on rule generation accuracy on our eval set.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Elena/Samir: confirm target monthly pilot budget cap (you mentioned ~USD 25k — confirm if that cap is firm).
2) Ben/Marissa (internal): run a conservative sensitivity with traverse sample-traffic (attached) and return a low/medium/high savings band by EOD tomorrow.
3) Elena: if procurement needs an initial PO or NDA before we hand over a VPC test project, please send contact and template.

I attached a short 2-page playbook that shows the modeled impact of batching + KV caching on a sample fintech workload and the sample-traffic CSV you shared on the call (redacted).

Proposed quick sync: Thurs 24 Jun, 10:00–10:30 PT? I can share a one-slide ROI model live.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: traversebank-econ-playbook.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); sample-traffic.csv (CSV, 58 KB)
From: Elena Soto <elena@traversebank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@traversebank.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: TraverseBank cost playbook & pilot asks

Thanks Mina — this is a helpful summary. A few clarifications from my side:

- Budget: USD 25k/month is our preferred cap for the pilot. We can stretch to 30k for the first month if we see immediate uplift, but procurement will require the cap in writing.
- Metrics: please include a simple per-feature breakdown (rule generation vs. scoring) in the ROI slide; our CFO wants the line-item view.
- Timeline: 90 days is fine. We need a deliverable at 30/60/90 days.
- Security: procurement asked for your SOC 2 Type II report and a brief description of data retention controls. Can you point me to the docs or attach?

If you can send the ROI slide and the model before Thu, we'll take a quick look and confirm the 10am slot.

On the technical side, Samir will follow up with some additional sample payloads.

Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Product Risk | TraverseBank
elena@traversebank.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: TraverseBank cost playbook & pilot asks

Mina / Marissa — quick note on the numbers in the playbook: I ran a fast sweep on the sample-traffic.csv and the continuous batching estimate in the attached PDF is optimistic if we assume their peak distribution has many short prompts with few shared prefixes.

Conservative bands I can push back to them:
- Low: 12% token savings (no KV cache benefit)
- Mid: 25% token savings (mix with 30% cache hit on templated prompts)
- High: 38% token savings (high reuse + aggressive batching)

I'll produce a 1-slide sensitivity chart for Thu so Elena has the low/med/high numbers for procurement. Also will attach SOC 2 pointer in the deck draft.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Solution Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@traversebank.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@traversebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: TraverseBank cost playbook & pilot asks

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and the budget confirmation.

Concrete mutual action plan (MAP)
- By EOD Wed 23 Jun: Redwood to send a 1-slide ROI (low/med/high) and the SOC 2 pointer + data retention summary. (Ben to finalize sensitivity slide.)
- Thu 24 Jun, 10:00 PT: 30-minute sync to review ROI and agree on acceptance criteria for 30/60/90 day checkpoints.
- Week of Mon 28 Jun: kick off technical onboarding (we'll need an internal admin contact and an initial service account).

Pilot constraints we understand and will honor
- Hard monthly cap: USD 25k (confirm in writing if procurement needs a PO).
- No production traffic; isolated test environment in your VPC.

Deliverables Redwood will provide
- ROI slide (low/med/high) and a short playbook for batching/cache config.
- A 90-day pilot runbook with acceptance criteria at 30/60/90 days.
- SOC 2 Type II pointer + data retention controls summary.

If that all sounds right, please reply with the confirmation of the 10am slot and Samir's preferred admin contact for onboarding. Once confirmed we'll issue a short statement of work (SOW) and an MSA link for signature.

Best,
Mina
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
